h: Avril Lavigne welcomes her first child, a daughter
p: Canadian singer Avril Lavigne, 42, has announced the birth of her first child, a daughter, sharing black-and-white photos on Instagram including a nod to her 2002 hit 'Sk8er Boi'.
body: Canadian pop-punk star Avril Lavigne has announced the birth of her first child.

In an Instagram post reported on Friday, 13 November 2026, the 42-year-old singer shared several black-and-white photos, including a close-up of her daughter's hand and a pair of chequered trainers on a skateboard, a nod to her 2002 hit 'Sk8er Boi'. She called the baby her little princess. She did not reveal the child's name or the father's identity.

Lavigne was previously married to Sum 41 frontman Deryck Whibley, whom she divorced in 2010, and later to Nickelback singer Chad Kroeger; they announced their separation in 2015. Her engagement to musician Mod Sun ended in 2023.
more: She did not reveal the father.
